description: This file defines an interface for accessing configuration options related to AWS STS regional endpoints, specifically providing methods to get the endpoints type and to convert the configuration into an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for STS regional endpoints configuration options.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the endpoints type as a string.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
